name: sheet
need: Show details or a form beside the page, in a panel from the side

--ds-sheet-padding.description: the side padding of head, body and foot at the comfortable density

--ds-sheet-radius.description: the panel's leading corners at the default shape

--ds-sheet-docked-width.description: a docked panel (`.ds-sheet__panel--push`, `--inspector`); the whole width of its layout at 480px and below

--ds-sheet-docked-border.description: the hairline between a docked panel and the content beside it

labExempt.DS.sheet.resizable: the width follows the pointer or steps with a key: no motion of its own

physical..ds-sheet__panel: border-radius: the side sheet slides in from the right edge: its open side is the left
physical..ds-sheet__panel::after: left: the bleed beyond the right edge covers the slide's overshoot
physical..ds-sheet .ds-sheet__resize: left: the modal sheet slides in from the right edge: its separator sits on the panel's left edge in every direction
physical..ds-sheet .ds-sheet__resize: right: the same separator: the logical start inset of the docked panels is taken back

exitUnpaired..ds-sheet--closing:not([data-state]) .ds: the opaque side sheet panel slides its full width off screen (D16); phones: down
